profile.name: 本地/远程文件与命令客户端
profile.description: 这不是特定的物理仪器，而是实验室自动化中用于访问本地或远程控制计算机的软件客户端，可进行文件上传、下载准备、文件下载以及命令执行，常用于部署实验脚本、传输数据和触发控制任务。
profile.description_en: This is not a specific physical instrument but a software client used in laboratory automation to access a local or remote control computer. It supports file upload, download preparation, file retrieval, and command execution, and is commonly used to deploy experiment scripts, transfer data, and trigger control tasks.

registry.name: Local Client
registry.description: Local Client是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括加载、运行。支持Signal, Slot, drain等操作。
